title: Run whose owner died -> failed orphaned
rule: specs/aip-58.mdx section 2 State machine -- "A running run MUST have a live owner"

timeline.event: worker-7 process killed (no clean shutdown, no host restart)
host liveness check detects expired lease with no live owner

notes: No host restart occurred in this scenario -- only worker-7 died. A host that only marks running runs failed on its OWN restart (the reference implementation's current behaviour) does not catch this case; the lease/heartbeat check is what does.
This is the vector for the '~25 app runs stuck running for weeks, several with 0 sessions' evidence in the Motivation.
